title: Existence of smooth normalized mollifier kernels supported in B(0,σ)
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ and every real σ > 0 there is a kernel ρ : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) with these properties: it is C^∞, i.e. ContDiff ℝ of order (⊤ : ℕ∞) (smooth of all finite orders, not the analytic class); it is nonnegative; its support lies in the open ball B(0,σ); and ∫_{ℝⁿ} ρ dLⁿ = 1 (Lebesgue measure volume).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (σ : ℝ), 0 < σ → ∃ ρ : Rn n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧ Function.support ρ ⊆ ball 0 σ ∧ ∫ x, ρ x = 1
